messages.subject: For loops in Ui.R
parts:
Hello,

I am using the sub-menu feature and I have some repeating code that I would like to put into a for loop, if it is possible. Would make my code cleaner and scaleable.

"criteria[1]" has a list of 10 strings and I would like to put this into a for loop.

I wanted to utilize the following as I did to repeat the radioButtons and sliderInput, but I wasn't able to get it to work.
lapply(1:noOfValueIntensityQuestions, function(i) {



navbarMenu("Value Input",
tabPanel(criteria[1],  
column(6,
lapply(1:noOfValueIntensityQuestions, function(i) {
        div(style="height: 100px;",radioButtons(paste0('criteriaAB', i), paste0(i, '.a) Which is more important?'),character(0),  choices =list(pestsList[pestCombinations[1,i]],pestsList[pestCombinations[2,i]]) ))
}) 
),
column(6,lapply(1:noOfValueIntensityQuestions, function(i) { 
 div(style="height: 100px;",   sliderInput(paste0('criteriaValue', i), paste0(i, '.b) How much more important'),min = 1, max = 9, value = 1))
})
), 
 
))
